About the Team
Pipedream enables AI agents to connect to the software and services people use every day -- including Notion, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, GitHub, Jira and thousands more. The platform is used by software developers at leading technology companies like Workday, Perplexity, Meta, and Relevance AI who are building AI agents and workflow products.

Pipedream offers something rare – the opportunity to work in a startup environment while delivering enterprise-scale impact (Pipedream was acquired by Workday in December 2025). If you enjoy moving fast, wearing multiple hats, and seeing your work directly shape a product's direction, this is a team where you can do exactly that.

As a Product Manager on the Pipedream Integrations team, you will help shape and deliver the roadmap for platform integrations, with a focus on enterprise applications and API-based connectivity. This role is closely aligned with the day-to-day work of building, improving, and maintaining integrations that customers and developers rely on.

You will work closely with engineering and partner teams to add and update integrated applications, define connector priorities, improve integration quality, and help the team use AI to increase integration velocity and throughput. This is a hands-on product role for someone who enjoys understanding how apps connect, identifying product gaps, and turning customer and platform needs into clear requirements.

In this role, you will be responsible for:
- Helping shape the roadmap for platform integrations, with a focus on enterprise applications

- Adding and updating integrated applications, including setting up OAuth clients

- Identifying product and functionality gaps based on customer needs and app integration requirements

- Defining product requirements that expand the capabilities, quality, and reliability of the platform

- Managing app approvals and working with partners to establish and maintain certifications

- Defining tool and connector priorities for integrated applications

- Troubleshooting and resolving issues reported by customers with existing integrations

- Driving the use of AI to improve integration velocity, throughput, and quality

- 5+ years of experience in product management or an equivalent technical role, including experience working on developer-facing products, integrations, APIs, infrastructure products, or cloud services

- Strong product judgment in scoping and phasing work, with the ability to identify a minimum viable version and sequence iterative improvements

- Strong understanding of API integrations, developer tools, enterprise applications, or cloud platforms, with the ability to read technical documentation, learn how different systems work, and apply that knowledge to improve connector quality and platform capabilities

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools

- Working knowledge of key AI concepts, including LLMs, agents, and MCP; experience prototyping or building agents is preferred

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- VISA Sponsorship  is not available for this role.

- Relocation support is not available for this role.

- Experience engaging customers and partners to gather requirements, understand product gaps, and turn feedback into clear product priorities

- Ability to communicate clearly with engineering, customers, partners, and cross-functional teams, including in asynchronous environments and across multiple time zones

- Intellectual curiosity and interest in learning new technologies, researching app requirements, reading API documentation, understanding certification needs, and investigating customer-reported issues

- Ability to evaluate trade-offs, prioritize connector work, and make thoughtful decisions with available information while balancing customer impact, technical complexity, quality, and business needs

- Experience managing vendor or partner relationships, ideally including certification, approval, or compliance processes

- Bonus points if you are able to write code or scripts, such as JavaScript or Python, and have familiarity with package managers such as npm or PyPI and GitHub

You will own a product line, not a feature backlog. You will have direct customer access, the autonomy to shape product decisions, and the mandate to turn Workday's data and domain knowledge into new categories of enterprise AI products.

We are hiring Senior and Principal Product Managers to own AI agent products from the earliest bet through GA and scale. This is a hands-on product-building role: you will turn ambiguous customer problems into prototypes, evals, launch scopes, and shipped products with engineering, design, data science, field, and domain teams.

- Own an AI agent product end-to-end, from opportunity discovery and product thesis through GA launch, adoption, and iteration.

- Identify and validate high-ROI opportunities in finance and HCM by working backward from real customer pain, business value, data availability, knowledge quality, and failure tolerance.

- Partner deeply with engineering to shape reliable agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and production readiness.

- Define product-quality evals that measure whether an agent is useful, trustworthy, and ready for customer use, not just whether a demo looks impressive.

- Build conviction through working demos, measurable results, customer discovery, design partner programs, and clear decision memos, not polished roadmap theater.

- Rally domain PMs, design, engineering, field, legal, security, and executives around the decisions needed to ship.

- 8+ years of product management, founder, product lead, or equivalent product-building experience for Senior Product Manager; 11+ years for Principal Product Manager.

- 5+ years building B2B or enterprise software where AI/ML, data, analytics, or decision-support products are central to the customer value proposition.

- Track record of 0-to-1 product development: you have taken something from concept to first customers, revenue, or measurable business impact.

- Demonstrated technical fluency with AI/ML systems, data or analytics products, enterprise platforms, or workflow automation.

- Experience using customer evidence, product metrics, and structured judgment to make high-stakes product decisions with incomplete information.

- High agency with modern AI tools: you use tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or equivalents to prototype, analyze, write, test, research, or automate parts of your own product workflow.

- Hands-on experience building, prototyping, or shipping AI agents, AI-native products, LLM features, workflow automation, decision-support systems, or data-intensive enterprise products.

- Strong intuition for agent evaluation, reliability, hallucination risk, human-in-the-loop design, permissions, auditability, and production failure modes.

- Experience in regulated or complex domains such as finance, HCM, healthcare, legal, planning, analytics, or enterprise operations.

- Experience managing design partner, beta, Early Adopter, or lighthouse customer programs.

- Strong product taste: you can simplify complex workflows into opinionated experiences that customers understand, trust, and adopt.

- You are already building with AI, whether at work, through side projects, prototypes, internal tools, or hands-on experimentation.

- You have strong opinions about where agents should act autonomously, where humans must stay in control, and how to prove the difference.

About the Role

We're looking for a business, product, and customer-oriented Senior Product Data Scientist to be the analytics partner for the Workday Data Cloud business. This role requires focused passion and excitement unlocking data insights that directly tie to strategic execution.

This role sits at the intersection of Workday's Data Cloud business, partnering directly with the Data Cloud organization (SVP/GM, Product Management, Engineering, and GTM teams) to bring analytical rigor and powerful business insights to a fast-growing, consumption-based product line. You will be the investigatory lead on a number of broad business questions. You will dive into the raw business data, find the root cause, and deliver an opinionated, decision-ready conclusion, not just more data.

You'll need to become a genuine subject-matter expert in Workday Data Cloud's business data landscape, working closely with the Workday Data Cloud GM and Product Management team. Your findings, and the curated data and documentation you produce along the way, should compound: feeding a shared knowledge base that makes the next question easier to answer, for you and for AI-assisted tooling built on top of the same body of work.

Key Responsibilities
- Serve as the business analytics domain expert for Workday Data Cloud, providing technical and strategic thought leadership.
- Partner cross-functionally across Go-To-Market (GTM) and Product teams to develop end-to-end views of the business, connecting the dots between top-of-funnel demand growth, sales pipeline, and downstream product usage.
- Translate complex data models into compelling narratives and stories (including interactive visualizations and executive presentations) that drive organizational clarity.
- Operate directly with SVP/GM-level stakeholders, translating a stream of layered, high-velocity questions into structured analysis without needing fully scoped requirements up front.
- Translate ambiguous business, data, and platform questions into simple and focused conclusions, independently and with strategic judgment
- Support consumption-based pricing and impact analysis for Workday Data Cloud, including sensitivity analysis, exploring new business models and driving business growth
- Navigate real data-maturity and instrumentation gaps with autonomy: identifying what already exists, what must be built, and when to escalate.
- Contribute well-documented, curated data assets and context back into the shared knowledge base so that analysis compounds over time and can eventually be self-served.
- Design and influence Workday Data Cloud internal business data connections, collaborating with Product Management and engineering teams on the design, scalability, and sustainability of associated pipelines.
- Leverage strong data ETL and data processing expertise to manage multi-step flows across product telemetry and observability systems
- Demonstrate urgency and autonomy in problem-solving, proactively navigating cross-functional teams to identify and implement solutions for both known and emerging business challenges.

About You

You possess a deep interest in grasping the complex challenges that businesses face, and you are excited by solving problems. You have strong business acumen and are outcomes focused. Learning new tools and technologies motivates you. You embody the qualities of an insightful, thoughtful, and reliable teammate - and you expect the same of your teammates. You thrive in a fast-paced, tech start-up like environment where the best ideas win. “Think Like a Scientist” is ingrained in how you work - always hypothesizing, always experimenting, always learning.

You're energized, not intimidated, by building trust, process, and domain expertise in a new, growing business space. You default to curating and documenting what you learn, because you know the same data landscape will get harder questions tomorrow. You're comfortable moving between hands-on data work and strategic, executive-level framing.

- 8+ years of experience with advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and/or data science
- 8+ years experience simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
- 6-8 years experience working autonomously in a highly matrixed, collaborative corporate environment.
- 5+ years experience in business/product analytics, applied data science, or a related quantitative role, ideally supporting a product or platform organization.
- 5+ years experience in enterprise BI platforms (e.g.,Tableau, Sigma )

Other Qualifications:
- Strong SQL and data-modeling skills; comfortable working directly in raw, partially documented, or partially instrumented datasets.
- Familiarity with front-end components or frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js, JavaScript) to help collaborate with engineering peers.
- Working familiarity with cloud data pipelines/ETL concepts (e.g., Airflow) sufficient to partner effectively with data engineering and platform product management teams.
- Experience with SaaS pricing analytics or usage-based/consumption pricing models specifically.
- Strong project management skills
- Experience applying organizational change management principles
- Experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework.
- Experience within the SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology industries
- Strong communication and data storytelling skills
- Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise production-level data science-based products for business decision-making
- Experience on AWS stack (Redshift, Sagemaker), scripting languages (Python and R)
- Degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related field) or equivalent practical experience.
